title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Trade School of the Province of Batangas to "Pablo Borbon Memorial School," in Honor of the Late Pablo Borbon, One of the Outstanding Sons of Said Province.

text.en:
The Trade School of the Province of Batangas shall hereafter be known as "Pablo Borbon
Memorial School," in honor of the memory of the late Pablo Borbon, Representative and Governor of said
province and Judge of the Court of First Instance.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1931.
